I'll pull your returns up now.

Your request to have that as money back instead is still with the supervisor, no decision yet.

Nothing else is out for return. The O. Bundle from that order is in transit, due around October 20, tracking ····.

Each new chat opens a fresh window on your screen, Jeff, so the old thread doesn't carry over visually. I still have it here, nothing is lost.

A copy of each conversation goes to (email hidden) when it closes, so your Friday chat should be in your inbox at that address. Worth checking spam too, our mail has been landing there for some people.

Anything from it you want me to pull up?
